note: Approved product claims the agent may use. Each claim keeps a source reference. Wording is deliberately conservative; confirm against current Sprinto materials before any real (non-demo) use. No pricing, guarantees, certification outcomes, or timelines may be stated.

capabilities.name: Compliance preparation
capabilities.approved_claim: Sprinto helps teams prepare for security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 by mapping controls and tracking readiness work in one place.
capabilities.short_claim: help mapping controls and tracking readiness work for frameworks like SOC 2 and ISO 27001

capabilities.name: Evidence collection
capabilities.approved_claim: Sprinto connects to common cloud and business systems to help collect compliance evidence instead of gathering it by hand for each audit.
capabilities.short_claim: integrations that help collect compliance evidence from connected systems

capabilities.name: Continuous control monitoring
capabilities.approved_claim: Sprinto monitors configured controls on an ongoing basis and flags controls that need attention between audits.
capabilities.short_claim: ongoing monitoring that flags controls needing attention between audits

capabilities.name: Customer trust documentation
capabilities.approved_claim: Sprinto helps teams share security and compliance information with customers, which can support responses to customer security reviews.
capabilities.short_claim: a way to share security and compliance information with customers during security reviews
